column1: For sugared cranberries, start the night before: simmer the water with 3/4 cup sugar until dissolved, cool 5 minutes, pour over the cranberries, and let sit 15 minutes.
Lift the cranberries out onto a lined sheet, dry 1 hour, toss in the remaining 1/2 cup sugar, and let dry at least 1 more hour.
Prepare the pie dough and chill it at least 2 hours.
Roll one disc of dough into a 12-inch circle, fit it into a 9-inch deep-dish pie dish, crimp or flute the edge, and brush the edge with egg wash.
Line the crust with parchment, fill with pie weights, and bake 10 minutes.
Remove the weights, prick the bottom with a fork, and bake 7–8 minutes more until just starting to brown.
Whisk the pumpkin, eggs, and brown sugar, then whisk in the cornstarch, salt, spices, pepper, cream, and milk until smooth.
Pour the filling into the warm crust, filling it about three quarters full.
Bake 55–60 minutes until only the very center wobbles, shielding the crust edges with foil after 25 minutes.
Cool on a rack for at least 3 hours.
If desired, cut leaves from the second dough disc, brush with egg wash, and bake at 350°F (177°C) about 10 minutes until lightly browned.
Decorate with the sugared cranberries and pastry leaves and serve with whipped cream if desired.
